author: toketrain
body:
Walls has seriously gone down in quality, and I believe player count as well, especially since the old classic maps were deleted. Jungle, Walls (original), Village, the old Tetris maps, all of these. It's really sad. I remember playing those maps with nice people and actually having fun. Now I go on and there's hardly anyone there, and they're all saying it's boring and lame. And don't pull that "oh well ur just nostalgiac. u cant go back to how it was oops lol" because those were damn good maps and there should at least be a classic rotation, like in Nebula. A chance for us to go back and revisit those maps. None of the new maps- there aren't any that I really recognize from when I started, except maybe one. The new maps are too flashy, too much. I think we need to go back and remember the plain maps where we could get our own supplies, make it on our own, all the core parts of what Walls meant. I'm sure the new maps are cool and hip and all but they're not really walls.

tldr please just put in a classic rotation. draw more players in and get some nostalgia goin. its fun. yea.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
If your just getting back into walls, try all of the maps. We have put some maps into rotation that are kind of on the level your looking for. Overworld and Smallcrypt have the same gameplay. The Village is still in rotation so that's one that was never removed. If you like TheVillage, lands has the same item mix and ore mix in the quads. We have even added a two team walls map and several maps like Pirates Cove that are theme based and require mining, but offer the adventure elements.


One point that I think you are  making, is that with so many more maps, with different  game play, it's hard to jump from style to style, and learn 20
Maps. With this said I have started working with some members of the dev team to bring more map options in the upcoming update. We hope to be able  to set custom rotations, this will allow us to set the maps we want on certain rotations. We will also be able to set the minimum players required to start a match per map. I am also working on a few maps for a rotation that brings back the feel from the past. Smaller maps, better resource management  and more focused on the players ability, not the loot found. This will allow us to hopefully keep players playing more and less waiting to play. Match this with the custom rotations, set maps, and faster starting times , and hopefully this will move the walls in an even better direction.

replies.author: potatoarmor
replies.body:
For what it's worth, I would like to see more "mini-maps" added.  Two or possibly three teams (not four), and five minute prep time.  Limited diamonds, if any.

Or if you leave it the way it is, cut the maps down to, say, eight maximum and put them on rotation.

Keep the other maps and rotate them in at the start of the month, and replace existing maps to keep the number at eight maximum.  So you have a pool of (for example) fifteen maps but only eight will be used in a given month.

There are some quality maps coming out but it is overwhelming trying to learn all the maps.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
@Armored: don't hold me to this , because things can change, but when we get the update we should be able to set distinct rotations for walls. I created the mini-maps to be fast, quick, simple to learn, and easy to get a game going. I hope to have a rotation with just those, and will start with only three players. I got 4 maps to put into that rotation. I also agree that part of walls is learning a map and with 25 maps, its just hard to do so I hope that when we change the rotations we will be able to have a lower amount of maps in those rotations. I look forward to doing what I can to grow the gamemode in a way that works for as many people as I can.
